snippet.title: Limbot Trailer
snippet.description:
Limbot is a super silly, physics-driven game about controlling the limbs of a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos (and camaraderie) of couch co-op play, in this fully destructible cardboard world! Coming to Steam and XBOX in 2026

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3335510/Limbot/
